STAFF OPENED OUR HOTEL ROOM DOOR WHILE NAKED. Unacceptable and disturbing experience. Front desk staff were rude and unprofessional. Alfredo in particular was dismissive and crossed the line into harassment.

We were given conflicting information by multiple employees, then outright refused accommodation as paying guests. Even more alarming, hotel staff repeatedly came to our room and at one point OPENED OUR DOOR WITHOUT CONSENT while we were naked. This was invasive, unsafe, and completely inappropriate.

The facilities were also unclean, adding to an already uncomfortable stay. This hotel has serious issues with staff conduct, guest privacy, and basic hospitality standards.

Do not stay here.

text.text:
I would not recommend the Orlando Inn International Drive Hotel to anyone. The cleanliness was far below average honestly, the place was filthy. I had to buy my own cleaning supplies just to make the room usable for one night. I scrubbed the bathroom, cleaned and disinfected the toilet, sink area, and even the nightstands because everything was dirty.

The room itself was in terrible condition. The lamps were rusted and covered in spiderwebs, there were roaches, and the bed sheets were stained. Even the lobby looked so dirty and uninviting that it made me regret checking in at all.

To make things worse, the staff was not friendly or welcoming. The only reason I stayed was because I checked in very late and needed a place to sleep, and thankfully there was a Walgreens next door where I bought the cleaning supplies I needed.

I will not be returning, and I strongly suggest others avoid this hotel.

text.text: This place is great. Worth your money. The front desk staff are amazing! Very friendly and super helpful. (Stay away from the concierge who will do anything to get you to attend a timeshare presentation that is an absolute nightmare). The rooms are clean and well cared for. Pool and outside amenities are great! Breakfast could be better, but it provides free fuel for the day. Our toilet flush and shower pressure were weak, ac was a little noisy, but honestly overall a very pleasant stay. For the price, unbeatable. I highly recommend.

text.text:
My stay was brief but enjoyable. For the price, I didn’t have super high expectations, but the experience ended up being better than I anticipated. The hotel was clean and comfortable, and is well situated relative Universal Orlando Resort (a 30 minute walk).

What really stood out the most was the level of hospitality. The front desk team was welcoming and helpful throughout my stay, and Tyreke in particular was incredibly friendly and informative. It’s always nice when staff go the extra mile to make guests feel comfortable.

Overall, it turned out to be a good stay and I would definitely consider coming back.

text.text: Great stay in a perfect location! The staff was very friendly and welcoming, and the guest rooms were comfortable and relaxing. The hotel is in a prime International Drive North location with quick access to the major theme parks. There are also many restaurants and entertainment options within walking distance, and the on-site parking is very convenient. Overall, a great place to stay when visiting Orlando.

text.text: This is listed on Google as a 3 star hotel but it's somewhere between a 1 and 2 star hotel at best. Photos are misleading.  When I was dropped off, I immediately wondered if the Uber driver dropped me off at the right place. See attached photo and compare it to the Google images. Guy at the desk was nice and got me checked in. When I got to my room, I immediately noticed a pungent and unpleasant chemical cleaning smell that was almost starting to give me a headache. The room was also grimy and not well cleaned. I couldn't even stay in the room long enough to research alternative arrangements on my phone so I hung out by the pool area to look on my phone. About 30 minutes after checking in, I told them I needed to check out and declined a different room because of the strong cleaning chemical smell in the first room. I stood there and argued for 5-10 minutes with the 2 desk people and some random guy that seemed to know them because the hotel refused to refund the $75 I paid for the room. This is all in the midst of Storm Fern while I'm trying to get back home from a trip but stranded in Orlando indefinitely until flights get figured out and I already don't know if I'm getting comped for other additional expenses. So now I have to worry about $75 for a hotel room they I didn't use and would have had no way of knowing I would have needed to cancel until I walked into the actual room. Don't forget to look at the photo I included and ask yourself if it looks like it matches up with the photos they put online. Once again this is a 2 star hotel AT BEST.

text.text: Stayed for three nights prices very reasonable rooms are cozy and quiet.  Too cold we weren’t able to use the pool, but the area is gorgeous. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. Took pictures on our last day rest assured the beds were made when we got here! Highly recommend! The balconies are a bonus. It feels like a little resort rather than your standard hotel room
